Vehicles are camouflaged using netting and disruptive camo patterns, enabling them to blend into surrounding terrain. Suitably outfitted, recon forces need only rely upon stealth and concealment rather than heavy armour for protection.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units (excluding TITANIC units) have Stealth.

detachmentAbilities.name: Artillery Support
detachmentAbilities.legend: Artillery barrages lay the ground for the assault to come.
detachmentAbilities.description: At the start of the battle round, select one of the following types of artillery support. Creeping Barrage: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit that is more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield: On a 5+, until the end of the battle round, that unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it. The maximum number of units that can be shaken by this rule in each battle round depends on the battle size, as shown below. Incendiary Bombardment: Select a number of enemy units more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are scattered. While a unit is scattered, it cannot have the Benefit of Cover. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below. Smoke Shells: Select a number of units from your army. Until the end of the battle round, those units have the Stealth ability. BATTLE SIZEMAXIMUM NUMBER OF UNITSIncursion2Strike Force3Onslaught4

detachmentAbilities.name: Masters of Camouflage
detachmentAbilities.legend: Reconnaissance infantry use face paint, camo-pattern fatigues, ghillie suits and more to conceal themselves from the foe. Vehicles are camouflaged using netting and disruptive camo patterns, enabling them to blend into surrounding terrain. Suitably outfitted, recon forces need only rely upon stealth and concealment rather than heavy armour for protection.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units (excluding TITANIC units) have Stealth.

detachmentAbilities.name: Ruthless Discipline
detachmentAbilities.legend: The officers of this company are wily, iron-willed veterans both respected and feared by the troops under their command. At their barked orders, even the weariest soldiers redouble their efforts.
detachmentAbilities.description: Add 1 to the number of Orders each Astra Militarum Officer model from your army can issue, as stated on their datasheet. While an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army is affected by an Order, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

detachmentAbilities.name: Artillery Support
detachmentAbilities.legend: Artillery barrages lay the ground for the assault to come.
detachmentAbilities.description: At the start of the battle round, select one of the following types of artillery support. Creeping Barrage: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit that is more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield: On a 5+, until the end of the battle round, that unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it. The maximum number of units that can be shaken by this rule in each battle round depends on the battle size, as shown below. Incendiary Bombardment: Select a number of enemy units more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are scattered. While a unit is scattered, it cannot have the Benefit of Cover. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below. Smoke Shells: Select a number of units from your army. Until the end of the battle round, those units have the Stealth ability. BATTLE SIZEMAXIMUM NUMBER OF UNITSIncursion2Strike Force3Onslaught4

detachmentAbilities.name: Iron Tread
detachmentAbilities.legend: The armoured spearhead of an Astra Militarum army group grinds relentlessly forward, ploughing through enemy infantry with arrogant disregard.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time a Squadron unit from your army Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it; until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit, and when making that Advance move, that unit can move within Engagement Range of enemy models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of enemy models.

detachmentAbilities.name: Born Soldiers
detachmentAbilities.legend: Regiments of numerous origins and tactical roles inculcate their soldiers from an early age with the legendary doctrines of the Tactica Imperium. Infantry train in close-range fire patterns intended to decimate enemy soldiers, whilst tank crews spend countless hours practising to bring down enemy armour and rampaging monstrosities.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time a model in a Regiment unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES), that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability. Each time a model in a Squadron unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

datasheets.name: Trojan Support Vehicle
datasheets.legend: Astra Militarum armoured companies and artillery regiments depend upon an extensive corps of support vehicles for their maintenance and rearmament. Amongst these is the Trojan; a crane-armed ammo mule tasked with keeping big guns firing, whether by replenishing supplies of shells and fuel or by facilitating simple battlefield repairs.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: heavy bolter; armoured tracks.

options.description: This model’s heavy bolter can be replaced with 1 heavy flamer.
This model can be equipped with 1 hunter-killer missile.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise
abilities.description: DEADLY DEMISE24.08From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat. This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").
abilities.legend: From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat.

abilities.name: Support Vehicle
abilities.description: In your Command phase, select one friendly Astra Militarum Vehicle model within 3" of this model. That VEHICLE model regains up to D3 lost wounds and, until the start of your next Command phase, each time that VEHICLE model makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. The same VEHICLE model cannot be selected for both this ability and the Regimental Enginseer’s Omnissiah’s Blessing ability in the same turn, and each model can only be selected for this ability once per Command phase.

abilities.name: One Shot
abilities.description: The bearer can only shoot with this weapon once per battle.

stratagems.name: VETERAN SHARPSHOOTERS
stratagems.legend: Marksmanship is a skill that only increases with experience.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army. TARGET: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was just taken for (even though your Battle-shocked units cannot normally be affected by your Stratagems). EFFECT: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even in retreat, the armoured fist of the Astra Militarum keep their cannons firing.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Falls Back. TARGET: That SQUADRON unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units). EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

stratagems.name: ACCURACY UNDER PRESSURE
stratagems.legend: Only the most disciplined soldiers and vehicle crews can maintain accuracy in the deafening confusion of an armoured clash.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: SMOKESCREEN
stratagems.legend: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase. TARGET: One friendly SMOKE unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets either your SMOKE unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your SMOKE unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

stratagems.name: BLAZING ADVANCE
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: By petitioning the machine spirits of their vehicles, tank crews push their armoured steeds beyond conventional limits.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Advances. TARGET: That SQUADRON unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: FURIOUS CANNONADE
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: At close range, armoured vehicles open up with their full complement of weapons, dispensing the Emperor’s righteous wrath.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One Squadron unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: COMBINED FIRE
stratagems.legend: Hammering the enemy, this transport’s crew share targeting solutions with nearby allies, allowing for concentrated combined fire to obliterate the foe’s infantry and even erode armour plating.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after an Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army has shot. TARGET: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover, and each time an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.

stratagems.name: ADDITIONAL ARMOUR
stratagems.legend: Veteran soldiers know the value of additional protection, whether welded to vehicles or worn under flak armour.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: ADAMANTINE BEHEMOTH
stratagems.legend: Barricades, trenches, bunkers and ruins: these obstacles are ground to dust by the obdurate advance of Astra Militarum armour.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase. TARGET: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: WITHERING FIREPOWER
stratagems.legend: Subjected to a thunderous volley of explosive shells and bullets, enemies begin to waver.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after an Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army has shot. TARGET: That ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.name: PURGING FIRE
stratagems.legend: Clear the area and defend your objectives. Take no prisoners.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by an Order that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: FINAL HOUR
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even with flames licking through the interior of their vehicle, this crew refuse to abandon their positions, regardless of the risk to their lives.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One Squadron unit from your army that is Below Half-strength (excluding Officer units). EFFECT: Until the end of the battle round, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons) have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: FIELDS OF FIRE
stratagems.legend: Armour and infantry work in concert, forming overlapping fields of fire against which neither cover nor heavy armour can protect.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One Regiment unit and one Squadron unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: CRUSHING IMPACT
stratagems.legend: In extremis, armoured vehicles and rampaging monsters can use their sheer size as a weapon, ramming and crushing enemies beneath their colossal bulk, though doing so risks sustaining damage in return.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER/VEHICLE unit ends a charge move. TARGET: That MONSTER/VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Select one model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit. Roll a number of D6 equal to the T characteristic of that model: for each 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds per unit).

stratagems.name: SUPPORTING ORDNANCE
stratagems.legend: This vehicle’s heavy weapons support lightly equipped infantry, suppressing enemy armour and bringing down lumbering monsters.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: STALWART PROTECTOR
stratagems.legend: The indefatigable tanks of the Astra Militarum serve as mobile cover for the troops marching in their shadow.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack is allocated to an INFANTRY model from your army, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of your VEHICLE, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

stratagems.name: ABLATIVE PLATING
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Wargear Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Crews routinely reinforce their vehicle's armour, adding ablative plating, track links, sandbags and other means to protect the hull.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVE CLEARANCE
stratagems.legend: A well-placed explosive munition in confined shipboard spaces can cause bloody carnage.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. Until the end of the phase, when determining how many models are in the target unit for the purpose of that ability, include models that are not visible to the attacking model. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

stratagems.name: CRASH THROUGH
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the grinding advance of an Astra Militarum armoured corps.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase. TARGET: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

stratagems.name: COORDINATED ACTION
stratagems.legend: The potency of armour and infantry is greatly enhanced when both work in close concert.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of any phase. TARGET: One Regiment unit from your army and one Squadron unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.

stratagems.name: OPENING SALVO
stratagems.legend: Emerging from their armoured transports, heavily armed soldiers open fire before enemies can dive for cover or angle their stoutest armour towards the fusillade.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks. TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT). EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

stratagems.name: MOBILE FIREBASE
stratagems.legend: Armoured fighting vehicles and transports keep pace with the infantry, supporting the advance as mobile gun platforms
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army Advances or Falls Back. TARGET: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought. TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

stratagems.name: NO RETREAT!
stratagems.legend: Battle-hardened and zealous, the company’s grizzled elites will gladly give their lives to honour the Emperor.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by the Duty and Honour! Order. EFFECT: If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

stratagems.name: BURST OF SPEED
stratagems.legend: Pushing bodies or engines to the limit, these warriors continue their swift advance.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your Movement phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase. EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

detachmentAbilities.legend: The heaviest Astra Militarum vehicles are adamantine behemoths whose armour is almost impenetrable. Roll a number of D6 equal to the T characteristic of that model: for each 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds per unit).

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: PURGING FIRE
stratagems.legend: Clear the area and defend your objectives. Take no prisoners.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by an Order that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: CRASH THROUGH
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the grinding advance of an Astra Militarum armoured corps.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase. TARGET: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

stratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks. TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units). EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

stratagems.name: BLAZING ADVANCE
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: By petitioning the machine spirits of their vehicles, tank crews push their armoured steeds beyond conventional limits.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Advances. TARGET: That SQUADRON unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: MOBILE FIREBASE
stratagems.legend: Armoured fighting vehicles and transports keep pace with the infantry, supporting the advance as mobile gun platforms
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army Advances or Falls Back. TARGET: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: OPENING SALVO
stratagems.legend: Emerging from their armoured transports, heavily armed soldiers open fire before enemies can dive for cover or angle their stoutest armour towards the fusillade.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVE CLEARANCE
stratagems.legend: A well-placed explosive munition in confined shipboard spaces can cause bloody carnage.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. Until the end of the phase, when determining how many models are in the target unit for the purpose of that ability, include models that are not visible to the attacking model. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

stratagems.name: ADAMANTINE BEHEMOTH
stratagems.legend: Barricades, trenches, bunkers and ruins: these obstacles are ground to dust by the obdurate advance of Astra Militarum armour.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase. TARGET: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: ACCURACY UNDER PRESSURE
stratagems.legend: Only the most disciplined soldiers and vehicle crews can maintain accuracy in the deafening confusion of an armoured clash.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: FURIOUS CANNONADE
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: At close range, armoured vehicles open up with their full complement of weapons, dispensing the Emperor’s righteous wrath.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One Squadron unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: BURST OF SPEED
stratagems.legend: Pushing bodies or engines to the limit, these warriors continue their swift advance.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your Movement phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase. EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army. TARGET: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was just taken for (even though your Battle-shocked units cannot normally be affected by your Stratagems). EFFECT: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought. TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

stratagems.name: NO RETREAT!
stratagems.legend: Battle-hardened and zealous, the company’s grizzled elites will gladly give their lives to honour the Emperor.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by the Duty and Honour! Order. EFFECT: If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.

stratagems.name: FIELDS OF FIRE
stratagems.legend: Armour and infantry work in concert, forming overlapping fields of fire against which neither cover nor heavy armour can protect.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One Regiment unit and one Squadron unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: SMOKESCREEN
stratagems.legend: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase. TARGET: One friendly SMOKE unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets either your SMOKE unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your SMOKE unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even in retreat, the armoured fist of the Astra Militarum keep their cannons firing.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Falls Back. TARGET: That SQUADRON unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: ADDITIONAL ARMOUR
stratagems.legend: Veteran soldiers know the value of additional protection, whether welded to vehicles or worn under flak armour.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: ABLATIVE PLATING
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Wargear Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Crews routinely reinforce their vehicle's armour, adding ablative plating, track links, sandbags and other means to protect the hull.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: FINAL HOUR
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even with flames licking through the interior of their vehicle, this crew refuse to abandon their positions, regardless of the risk to their lives.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One Squadron unit from your army that is Below Half-strength (excluding Officer units). EFFECT: Until the end of the battle round, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons) have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: VETERAN SHARPSHOOTERS
stratagems.legend: Marksmanship is a skill that only increases with experience.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

stratagems.name: COORDINATED ACTION
stratagems.legend: The potency of armour and infantry is greatly enhanced when both work in close concert.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of any phase. TARGET: One Regiment unit from your army and one Squadron unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.

stratagems.name: SUPPORTING ORDNANCE
stratagems.legend: This vehicle’s heavy weapons support lightly equipped infantry, suppressing enemy armour and bringing down lumbering monsters.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

detachmentAbilities.name: Artillery Support
detachmentAbilities.legend: Artillery barrages lay the ground for the assault to come.
detachmentAbilities.description: At the start of the battle round, select one of the following types of artillery support. Creeping Barrage: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit that is more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield: On a 5+, until the end of the battle round, that unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it. The maximum number of units that can be shaken by this rule in each battle round depends on the battle size, as shown below. Incendiary Bombardment: Select a number of enemy units more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are scattered. While a unit is scattered, it cannot have the Benefit of Cover. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below. Smoke Shells: Select a number of units from your army. Until the end of the battle round, those units have the Stealth ability. BATTLE SIZEMAXIMUM NUMBER OF UNITSIncursion2Strike Force3Onslaught4

detachmentAbilities.name: Ruthless Discipline
detachmentAbilities.legend: The officers of this company are wily, iron-willed veterans both respected and feared by the troops under their command. At their barked orders, even the weariest soldiers redouble their efforts.
detachmentAbilities.description: Add 1 to the number of Orders each Astra Militarum Officer model from your army can issue, as stated on their datasheet. While an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army is affected by an Order, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

detachmentAbilities.name: Masters of Camouflage
detachmentAbilities.legend: Reconnaissance infantry use face paint, camo-pattern fatigues, ghillie suits and more to conceal themselves from the foe. Vehicles are camouflaged using netting and disruptive camo patterns, enabling them to blend into surrounding terrain. Suitably outfitted, recon forces need only rely upon stealth and concealment rather than heavy armour for protection.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units (excluding TITANIC units) have Stealth.

detachmentAbilities.name: Born Soldiers
detachmentAbilities.legend: Regiments of numerous origins and tactical roles inculcate their soldiers from an early age with the legendary doctrines of the Tactica Imperium. Infantry train in close-range fire patterns intended to decimate enemy soldiers, whilst tank crews spend countless hours practising to bring down enemy armour and rampaging monstrosities.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time a model in a Regiment unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES), that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability. Each time a model in a Squadron unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

detachmentAbilities.name: Iron Tread
detachmentAbilities.legend: The armoured spearhead of an Astra Militarum army group grinds relentlessly forward, ploughing through enemy infantry with arrogant disregard.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time a Squadron unit from your army Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it; until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit, and when making that Advance move, that unit can move within Engagement Range of enemy models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of enemy models.

detachmentAbilities.name: Ceaseless Cannonade
detachmentAbilities.legend: The heaviest Astra Militarum vehicles are adamantine behemoths whose armour is almost impenetrable. The crews of these colossal war engines need have no concern for the integrity of their vehicles, unleashing even the most violently destructive ordnance at point-blank range.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time an Astra Militarum Titanic or Astra Militarum Squadron unit from your army is selected to shoot, models in that unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of that unit (including with Blast weapons), provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. When doing so, such models do not suffer the penalty to their Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units (excluding attacks made with Indirect Fire weapons). KEYWORDS In the Muster Armies step, you can select one or more ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC units from your army to gain the CHARACTER keyword. Designer’s Note: This means that the selected units can be given Enhancements, and one of them can be selected as your WARLORD.

datasheets.name: Tauros Assault Vehicle
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: heavy flamer; armoured frame.

options.description: This model’s heavy flamer can be replaced with 1 Tauros grenade launcher.
This model can be equipped with 1 hunter-killer missile.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise
abilities.description: DEADLY DEMISE24.08From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat. This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").
abilities.legend: From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat.

abilities.name: Scouts
abilities.legend: Scouts form the vanguard of many armies. Unnoticed by the enemy, they range ahead of the main force.

abilities.name: Turbo-boost
abilities.description: Each time this model Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of this model.

abilities.name: One Shot
abilities.description: The bearer can only shoot with this weapon once per battle.

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit. EFFECT: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes: Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance. +1CPInto the Fray: When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6. When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: CLEAR AND SECURE
stratagems.legend: Mechanised charges rely upon shock, awe and speed to secure ground. Any enemies that block the path must be obliterated swiftly.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: SCOUTING OUTRIDERS
stratagems.legend: Sentinels and cavalry units use their speed and mobility to outflank the foe, ready to strike at the most opportune moment.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s turn. TARGET: One Astra Militarum Mounted or Astra Militarum Walker unit from your army that is wholly within 10" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT). EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

stratagems.name: ON MY POSITION
stratagems.legend: Circling Aeronautica Imperialis strike fighters wait above to launch strafing runs should the attack falter. In extremis, these assets can be called down upon Imperial positions in danger of being overrun, affording soldiers the desperate dignity of taking their enemies with them into death.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly engaged REGIMENT unit. EFFECT: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit engaged with your unit: On a 2+ that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds. Then, your unit suffers 3D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: MOVE OUT
stratagems.legend: High command’s priorities have shifted. Swift embarkation and redeployment is required.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s turn. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army. EFFECT: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an Astra Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.

stratagems.legend: These soldiers scream blood-curdling battle cries as they rush forwards, emboldening their squadmates and causing the enemy to waver.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase. TARGET: One Astra Militarum Infantry or Astra Militarum Mounted unit from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and each time an enemy model makes an attack, if your unit is the closest eligible target, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: ACCURACY UNDER PRESSURE
stratagems.legend: Only the most disciplined soldiers and vehicle crews can maintain accuracy in the deafening confusion of an armoured clash.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: ADDITIONAL ARMOUR
stratagems.legend: Veteran soldiers know the value of additional protection, whether welded to vehicles or worn under flak armour.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

detachmentAbilities.name: Armoured Fist
detachmentAbilities.legend: Astra Militarum mechanised forces combine heavy armour with elite infantry. Reliant on speed and short-ranged firepower, the armoured spearhead hurtles through the enemy line and deploys its cargo of shock troops to cut the enemy down with volleys of lasgun fire.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time an ASTRA MILITARUM model from your army makes a ranged attack in a turn in which it disembarked from a Transport, add 1 to the Wound roll.

detachmentAbilities.name: Masters of Camouflage
detachmentAbilities.legend: Reconnaissance infantry use face paint, camo-pattern fatigues, ghillie suits and more to conceal themselves from the foe. Vehicles are camouflaged using netting and disruptive camo patterns, enabling them to blend into surrounding terrain. Suitably outfitted, recon forces need only rely upon stealth and concealment rather than heavy armour for protection.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units (excluding TITANIC units) have Stealth.

detachmentAbilities.name: Born Soldiers
detachmentAbilities.legend: Regiments of numerous origins and tactical roles inculcate their soldiers from an early age with the legendary doctrines of the Tactica Imperium. Infantry train in close-range fire patterns intended to decimate enemy soldiers, whilst tank crews spend countless hours practising to bring down enemy armour and rampaging monstrosities.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time a model in a Regiment unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES), that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability. Each time a model in a Squadron unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

detachmentAbilities.name: Artillery Support
detachmentAbilities.legend: Artillery barrages lay the ground for the assault to come.
detachmentAbilities.description: At the start of the battle round, select one of the following types of artillery support. Creeping Barrage: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit that is more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield: On a 5+, until the end of the battle round, that unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it. The maximum number of units that can be shaken by this rule in each battle round depends on the battle size, as shown below. Incendiary Bombardment: Select a number of enemy units more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are scattered. While a unit is scattered, it cannot have the Benefit of Cover. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below. Smoke Shells: Select a number of units from your army. Until the end of the battle round, those units have the Stealth ability. BATTLE SIZEMAXIMUM NUMBER OF UNITSIncursion2Strike Force3Onslaught4

detachmentAbilities.name: Ruthless Discipline
detachmentAbilities.legend: The officers of this company are wily, iron-willed veterans both respected and feared by the troops under their command. At their barked orders, even the weariest soldiers redouble their efforts.
detachmentAbilities.description: Add 1 to the number of Orders each Astra Militarum Officer model from your army can issue, as stated on their datasheet. While an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army is affected by an Order, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

datasheets.name: Tauros Venator
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: twin multi-laser; armoured frame.

options.description: This model’s twin multi-laser can be replaced with 1 twin lascannon.
This model can be equipped with 1 hunter-killer missile.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise
abilities.description: DEADLY DEMISE24.08From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat. This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").
abilities.legend: From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat.

abilities.name: Mobile Hunter-killer
abilities.description: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

abilities.name: One Shot
abilities.description: The bearer can only shoot with this weapon once per battle.

stratagems.name: NO RETREAT!
stratagems.legend: Battle-hardened and zealous, the company’s grizzled elites will gladly give their lives to honour the Emperor.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by the Duty and Honour! Order. EFFECT: If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.

stratagems.name: FIELDS OF FIRE
stratagems.legend: Armour and infantry work in concert, forming overlapping fields of fire against which neither cover nor heavy armour can protect.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One Regiment unit and one Squadron unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought. TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units). EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

stratagems.name: MOVE OUT
stratagems.legend: High command’s priorities have shifted. Swift embarkation and redeployment is required.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s turn. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army. EFFECT: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an Astra Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: ADDITIONAL ARMOUR
stratagems.legend: Veteran soldiers know the value of additional protection, whether welded to vehicles or worn under flak armour.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: BURST OF SPEED
stratagems.legend: Pushing bodies or engines to the limit, these warriors continue their swift advance.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your Movement phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase. EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT). EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks. TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army. TARGET: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was just taken for (even though your Battle-shocked units cannot normally be affected by your Stratagems). EFFECT: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit. EFFECT: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes: Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance. +1CPInto the Fray: When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6. When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: ACCURACY UNDER PRESSURE
stratagems.legend: Only the most disciplined soldiers and vehicle crews can maintain accuracy in the deafening confusion of an armoured clash.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: COURAGEOUS DIVERSION
stratagems.legend: These soldiers scream blood-curdling battle cries as they rush forwards, emboldening their squadmates and causing the enemy to waver.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase. TARGET: One Astra Militarum Infantry or Astra Militarum Mounted unit from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and each time an enemy model makes an attack, if your unit is the closest eligible target, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: PURGING FIRE
stratagems.legend: Clear the area and defend your objectives. Take no prisoners.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by an Order that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

stratagems.name: VETERAN SHARPSHOOTERS
stratagems.legend: Marksmanship is a skill that only increases with experience.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVE CLEARANCE
stratagems.legend: A well-placed explosive munition in confined shipboard spaces can cause bloody carnage.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. Until the end of the phase, when determining how many models are in the target unit for the purpose of that ability, include models that are not visible to the attacking model. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

stratagems.name: OPENING SALVO
stratagems.legend: Emerging from their armoured transports, heavily armed soldiers open fire before enemies can dive for cover or angle their stoutest armour towards the fusillade.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: CLEAR AND SECURE
stratagems.legend: Mechanised charges rely upon shock, awe and speed to secure ground. Any enemies that block the path must be obliterated swiftly.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: ON MY POSITION
stratagems.legend: Circling Aeronautica Imperialis strike fighters wait above to launch strafing runs should the attack falter. In extremis, these assets can be called down upon Imperial positions in danger of being overrun, affording soldiers the desperate dignity of taking their enemies with them into death.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly engaged REGIMENT unit. EFFECT: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit engaged with your unit: On a 2+ that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds. Then, your unit suffers 3D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: COORDINATED ACTION
stratagems.legend: The potency of armour and infantry is greatly enhanced when both work in close concert.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of any phase. TARGET: One Regiment unit from your army and one Squadron unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.

stratagems.name: SCOUTING OUTRIDERS
stratagems.legend: Sentinels and cavalry units use their speed and mobility to outflank the foe, ready to strike at the most opportune moment.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s turn. TARGET: One Astra Militarum Mounted or Astra Militarum Walker unit from your army that is wholly within 10" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.legend: The indefatigable tanks of the Astra Militarum serve as mobile cover for the troops marching in their shadow.

stratagems.legend: Subjected to a thunderous volley of explosive shells and bullets, enemies begin to waver.

stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even with flames licking through the interior of their vehicle, this crew refuse to abandon their positions, regardless of the risk to their lives.
